name: Solve Intelligence
description: Connect to Solve Intelligence for patent workflows directly in Claude. Search across patent and non-patent literature, legal texts and case law, SEP technical standards, and the open web. Ask Claude to find prior art or infringing products, conduct legal research, map claims to standards, and analyse or draft patent documents.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Solve Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Solve Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.solveintelligence.com/mcp/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Solve Intelligence MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solve Intelligence provides these MCP tools: search_patents, get_patent_content, search_npl, lookup_patent_search_entities, list_patent_law_and_standards, read_patent_law_and_standard, search_patent_law_and_standards, grep_patent_law_and_standards, and get_patent_search_guidance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Solve Intelligence?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Solve Intelligence in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Solve Intelligence MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solve Intelligence requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Solve Intelligence is developed by Solve Intelligence. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
